subject: HANDOFF: Fold7 physical-panel ID cache recovery contract
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-state-rd-physical-panel-id-revalidation-20261002. WORKSTREAM_STATE=COMPLETE_RND_HANDOFF. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=7a612a0fe3181768f548a1ec78d2c3ee5938a339; FINAL_REVALIDATED_MAIN_SHA=f925daab6526371af0c0cf8425a4647a02af95c7; relevant DuoShellService blob unchanged at c0d1bfedc602307f148538915cffc8cef860a2a2, so intervening main drift does not obsolete the result. PRIMARY TAKEAWAY: do not replace the current physical-ID cache with per-transition probing. AOSP supports stable physical IDs and Duo already resolves the current binder token per power call. Add only a bounded self-heal for definite token absence: exact role/id/revision invalidation -> one geometry re-resolution -> one token/power retry -> stop. Generic power exceptions after a valid token are not identity proof and should not evict cache. Prototype/tests are complete and packaged; field/device validation remains required before integration priority is raised. Suggested device matrix: capture SurfaceFlinger/dumpsys physical IDs before/after repeated fold cycles, screen off/on, app/accessibility restart while shell survives if possible, and optionally compositor restart only in a lab-safe context; verify no false cache invalidation and confirm recovery if an ID actually disappears. MANUAL_PRIMARY_INTEGRATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED=YES. No production source changes, commits, workflows, APKs, or installations were authorized or performed by this agent.
